title: FinTrack – Personal Finance App
description: A cross-platform budgeting app with bank-style transaction sync, smart category insights and monthly spending forecasts.
problem: Users were juggling multiple banking apps and spreadsheets with no clear picture of monthly cash flow.
solution: Built a Flutter finance app with offline-first sync, category insights, biometric login, and forecast charts.
role: Lead Flutter engineer — product UI, state management, Firebase, App Store & Play Store release.
impact: 4.8★ store rating · 12k+ downloads in first quarter

title: MediCare Admin Dashboard
description: Clinic management dashboard handling appointments, patient records, billing and staff roles for a multi-location healthcare group.
problem: Twelve clinic locations tracked patients and billing across disconnected tools.
solution: Delivered a role-based admin panel with live occupancy, appointment queues, and billing exports.
role: Full-stack — Flutter Web UI, Node API, PostgreSQL schema, ops training.
impact: Ops team saves ~15 hours/week on manual admin work

title: ShopEase E-commerce Website
description: Conversion-focused storefront with product filtering, guest checkout and Stripe payments.
problem: Legacy storefront was slow on mobile and leaking conversions at checkout.
solution: Rebuilt the storefront for performance, clearer UX, and Stripe guest checkout.
role: Frontend + payments integration, performance pass, launch support.

title: RideNow Delivery App UI/UX
description: End-to-end product design for a last-mile delivery startup: flows, wireframes, and a high-fidelity prototype.
problem: Founders needed a clear product vision before investing in engineering.
solution: Mapped user journeys and delivered a 40-screen prototype with a reusable design system.
role: Product designer — research synthesis, UI kit, interactive prototype.
impact: Design system cut engineering UI build time by ~30%

title: EduLearn LMS Admin Panel
description: Learning management back office for course publishing, cohort progress, certificates and instructor payouts.
problem: Instructors and admins lacked a single place to manage courses and student progress.
solution: Built an LMS admin with cohorts, certificates, and payouts for 8,000+ students.

title: FitPulse Fitness Tracker App
description: Workout and habit tracker with wearable sync, streak mechanics and coach messaging.
problem: Early fitness users abandoned tracking apps that felt cluttered and unmotivating.
solution: Shipped a focused Flutter tracker with streaks, wearables, and coach chat.
role: Lead Flutter engineer — HealthKit/Google Fit, Firebase, store releases.
impact: 4.8★ on both stores after a 3-month launch cycle
